protocol_policy.normal_output: actual screenSeq when available plus session-local monotonic chunkId; no replayToken
protocol_policy.snapshot_recovery_output: exact replayToken plus actual screenSeq and stable chunkId
protocol_policy.direct_repair_output: screenSeq and stable chunkId on wire; repairToken is transport metadata only
protocol_policy.frontend_tokenless_before_ready: accepted only with finite screenSeq and stable chunkId so snapshot coverage is decidable
protocol_policy.frontend_tokenless_after_ready: legacy or degraded tokenless output may be admitted after the exact matching replay ready latch
protocol_policy.supersession: only exact session/replayToken or session/repairToken recovery frames are removed; unrelated and normal live output remains queued
protocol_policy.coalescing: replay-tagged or different-sequence frames never coalesce; same or unknown-sequence normal output may coalesce while retaining a stable frame identity
